verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. The pack confirms a first-party MCP server documentation page exists at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server, but it shows nothing about how an agent connects, authenticates, or what tools are exposed. missing for 10: documented connection/setup steps for agents, authentication details, exposed tool/resource list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
